facts: The paper presents the results of automatically inducing a Combinatory Categorial Grammar (CCG) lexicon from a Turkish dependency treebank.
The results are of automatically inducing a Combinatory Categorial Grammar (CCG) lexicon.
A Combinatory Categorial Grammar (CCG) lexicon was automatically induced.
The Combinatory Categorial Grammar (CCG) lexicon is from a Turkish dependency treebank.
Turkish is an agglutinating free word order language.
The fact that Turkish is an agglutinating free word order language presents a challenge for language theories.
Possible ways to obtain a compact lexicon were explored.
entities: automatically inducing a Combinatory Categorial Grammar ( CCG ) lexicon
